gloss: Go stone; game piece for Go

definitions.gloss: Go stone; game piece for Go
definitions.explanation: The round, flat stones used as playing pieces in the board game Go (囲碁). They come in two colors — black (黒石) and white (白石) — and are placed on the intersections of a grid.

examples.japanese: {黒|くろ}い{碁石|ごいし}を{先|さき}に{打|う}つ。
{高級|こうきゅう}な{碁石|ごいし}は{蛤|はまぐり}の{殻|から}から{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: High-quality Go stones are made from clamshells.

notes:
Compound of {碁|ご} (Go, the board game) and {石|いし} (stone). Traditional high-quality white stones are made from {蛤|はまぐり} (hard clam) shells from {日向|ひゅうが} in Miyazaki Prefecture, while black stones are made from {那智黒石|なちぐろいし} (Nachi black stone), a type of slate. Everyday sets use glass or plastic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {碁石|ごいし}を{打|う}つ — to play a Go stone
- {碁石|ごいし}を{置|お}く — to place a Go stone
- {黒石|くろいし} — black stone
- {白石|しろいし} — white stone

RELATED WORDS:
- {囲碁|いご} — Go (the board game)
- {碁盤|ごばん} — Go board
- {碁|ご} — Go (short form)
- {将棋|しょうぎ} — shogi; Japanese chess (another traditional board game)
